title: Group with InnoShow winner sign and framed certificate in front of InnoShow banners
objects_and_counts: Four people are visible standing side-by-side in the photographed scene; all four are wearing face masks (three appear light blue surgical masks and one appears pink), and all are visible from approximately knee to head.
One person at far left is holding a white skateboard-like object vertically in front of their torso; the skateboard is mostly visible but its top is cropped by the person's hands.
One person second from left is holding a large cut-out sign that reads WINNER and InnoShow Award; the sign is fully visible and held at waist height in front of that person.
One person second from right is holding a framed certificate/plaque; the rectangular frame is visible and being presented with assistance from the person at far right.
Two tall vertical roll-up banners are visible behind the group: a central banner with botanical/green graphic elements and a right-side banner with large vertical text.
One computer monitor (cropped) and one keyboard are visible on the left side of the counter behind the group; both are partially visible and partly obscured by the person at far left.
A long countertop or bench with perforated white front panels runs behind the group across the width of the image.

The two roll-up banners are positioned behind the group: one banner with green botanical graphics is approximately centered behind them and the other banner with large vertical text is slightly to the right behind the group.
A window is visible behind the banners toward the left and center of the image, and the countertop with perforated white front panels runs horizontally behind the group at roughly waist height.
The partially visible computer monitor and keyboard are on the countertop to the left of the person at far left; they are partially obscured by that person.

The skateboard-like object is white with some small darker components near its lower end; it appears to be made of a smooth, possibly painted or composite material.
